g.text: With shared starting states, proposal choice produces the large search gain

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Frozen hypothesis supported: +66.36 pp certified gain; one-sided 95% endpoints [65.43, 67.28].

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All arms use identical inherited BP AdamW weights and source temperature · primary arms share every initial-state byte

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Primary: change proposals while holding permutation initialization fixed. Descriptive comparison: change initialization with arbitrary proposals fixed.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The shared support ceiling is 87.26% (dotted); permutation proposals miss only 0 / 1 / 2 supported inputs across seeds.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Shared saved initial states and separate RNG streams prevent earlier search blocks from altering later initialization. All nine searches are fresh.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Permutation swaps change four cells and cost more per move. They use 100.36 s of measured search time versus 65.82 s for the shared-start

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: arbitrary kernel. Equal proposal caps do not imply equal FLOPs or wall time; this establishes a quality gain, not a speedup.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: 737,280 states independently audited; zero wrong stops. Confidence bounds cluster three search seeds within each of 4,096 fresh inputs; one inherited fit.
